questions.title: Who is moving into the trade area?
questions.body: Validate household growth, age mix, and insurance coverage across the actual service area.

questions.title: Where is employment expanding?
questions.body: Look for durable job growth, new employers, and commute patterns that support access.

questions.title: How much care is already nearby?
questions.body: Map comparable services, capacity, and referral patterns before reading growth as unmet demand.
